import json, urllib.request
tok = open("/root/nocodb-token.txt").read().strip()
NC = "http://localhost:8080"
def get(p):
    r = urllib.request.Request(NC + p, headers={"xc-token": tok})
    return json.loads(urllib.request.urlopen(r, timeout=20).read().decode())
for b in get("/api/v2/meta/bases")["list"]:
    for t in get("/api/v2/meta/bases/%s/tables" % b["id"])["list"]:
        if t["title"] != "Клієнти": continue
        print("ТАБЛИЦЯ Клієнти:", t["id"], "| база:", b["title"])
        cols = get("/api/v2/meta/tables/%s" % t["id"])["columns"]
        print("КОЛОНКИ:", ", ".join(c["title"] for c in cols))
        rows = get("/api/v2/tables/%s/records?limit=500" % t["id"])["list"]
        print("усього клієнтів:", len(rows))
        hits = [r for r in rows if "гранд" in json.dumps(r, ensure_ascii=False).lower()]
        print("знайдено за «гранд»:", len(hits))
        for r in hits:
            print("=" * 55)
            for k, v in r.items():
                print("  %-30s = %s" % (k, "" if v in (None, "", [], {}) else str(v)[:110]))
